messages:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered: inference-gen latency > 3s in eu-west-1 (multiple 5xx and slowgen). Page sent to oncall rotation. Incident INC-44789.

jordan: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs + traces. ETA 10m.

emma: +1. I'm running kv-cache health check and checking autoscaling events.

jordan: initial triage: gen-queue backlog; a couple hosts OOM'd and were replaced. Traffic spiked due to batch heuristic change at 09:12 UTC.

maria: heads up — product & comms: need a short status page update. Draft below, please review quickly. @jordan @emma

maria: Draft (please keep <5 lines):
```
Status: Under investigation
Component: Generation & Embeddings (eu-west-1)
Impact: Elevated response times and intermittent 5xx for some requests since ~09:12 UTC.
Customer guidance: Retry after 30s; we are actively mitigating. No data loss expected.
```

sam: Suggest adding "affects streaming endpoints" — I saw errors across streaming APIs too.

jordan: good call. Updated draft: change component line to include streaming.

emma: Mitigation: scaled up replacement pool and reverted batch heuristic for the affected subset. Backlog decreasing but still processing. CPU/GPU utilization trending down.

jordan: Proposed publish cadence: initial within 10m, periodic updates every 30m, resolved when backlog cleared + 15m stable. Who posts initial?

maria: I can post initial + one 30m update. Need confirm copy and request legal signoff only if customer data exposed (looks like not).

legal: quick confirm — no signal of data exposure so no legal review required for initial copy. If that changes ping us.

jordan: I'll add metrics snapshot to thread for the ops note:
```
backlog: 42 -> 14 (last 12m)
5xx rate: 2.3% -> 0.7%
avg latency: 3.8s -> 2.1s
```

maria: Final copy approved. @sam can you add note about affected endpoints in the public draft?

sam: Done — added "streaming, generation, and embeddings" line.

maria: I'll post initial status page update now (T+12m). Posting note: "We are investigating elevated latency affecting generation, streaming, and embeddings in eu-west-1. Engineering is actively mitigating." Will update in 30m or sooner.

jordan: continuing monitoring. I'll follow up with resolve notice once stable for 15m.

emma: adding incident actions to postmortem: revert batch heuristic, add safety to autoscaler threshold, add preflight for batch config changes.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-44789: update posted by maria at 4478901300. Next update scheduled 30m.

jordan: thanks team. keep thread tight — only ops/comm updates here.
